import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Files in archive:", z.namelist())

# Shared strings
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
        # Concatenate all t elements
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

# Read first sheet
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rns = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
rid_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}Relationship')}
first_sheet = wb.find('m:sheets', ns).find('m:sheet', ns)
print("Sheet name:", first_sheet.get('name'))
rid = first_sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
sheet_path = 'xl/' + rid_map[rid].lstrip('/')
print("Sheet path:", sheet_path)

sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheet_path))
rows = []
for row in sheet.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
    r = []
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == 's' and val is not None:
            val = shared[int(val)]
        elif t == 'inlineStr':
            is_el = c.find('m:is', ns)
            val = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in is_el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        r.append((ref, val))
    rows.append(r)

for r in rows:
    print(r)
EOF

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
ODOC = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Files in archive:", z.namelist())

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('{%s}si' % NS):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t' % NS))
        shared.append(text)

wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rid_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels.findall('{%s}Relationship' % REL)}
first_sheet = wb.find('{%s}sheets' % NS).find('{%s}sheet' % NS)
print("Sheet name:", first_sheet.get('name'))
rid = first_sheet.get('{%s}id' % ODOC)
sheet_path = 'xl/' + rid_map[rid].lstrip('/')
print("Sheet path:", sheet_path)

sheet = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheet_path))
for row in sheet.iter('{%s}row' % NS):
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall('{%s}c' % NS):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('{%s}v' % NS)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == 's' and val is not None:
            val = shared[int(val)]
        elif t == 'inlineStr':
            is_el = c.find('{%s}is' % NS)
            val = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in is_el.iter('{%s}t' % NS))
        cells.append((ref, val))
    print(cells)
